features.name: Agent browsers
features.description: Show the Browser panel to opt in to local browser tools and inspect agent browser sessions. Hiding the panel does not disable enabled tools.

features.name: Agent Session Continuity
features.description: Tune idle residency and turn-count rotation, carry a bounded local handoff across predictable sleep, and warn on oversized standing prefixes. Applies when managed agents next start.

features.name: Agent Replay Hygiene
features.description: Persist relay-verified answered mentions so managed agents do not replay them after restart. Applies when managed agents next start.

features.name: Dispatch
features.description: Workspace issue boards, triage, and assignment

features.name: Pulse
features.description: Activity feed with notes, social posts, and agent activity

features.name: Summary
features.description: Personal daily briefing in Pulse, from the channels and DMs you belong to

features.name: Forum Channels
features.description: Forum-style threaded channels for long-form discussions

features.name: Agent-managed profiles
features.description: Let agents manage their own relay name and avatar instead of restoring the desktop copy

features.name: Remote Control
features.description: See and manage agents that run on another Mac from this device

features.name: Agent usage
features.description: Per-agent token usage, sessions, and turn provenance read from this device's local archive
